about: Modwerk source-only note-octave package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/note-octave.

mods.title: Note Octave
mods.summary: FUNC + turn on a trig's note moves it by an octave, on audio and MIDI tracks.
mods.description: On the TRIG page, FUNC + turn on NOTE or NOT1 to NOT4 moves the note an octave every three detents instead of stock's jump; with a trig held it moves that step's lock.
mods.author: draadpiraat
mods.on_unit: Tried on the author's Digitakt I, OS 1.54 (NO08, which this package reproduces byte for byte with Core 2.1), 2026-11-16.
